posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast white circular spots are visible, located on the lateral posterior haunch midway down the thigh.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a lyrate spiral trajectory, angling posteriorly and laterally from the base before curving medially towards the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated distance between the terminal tips is 1.6 times the width of a single horn base.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron mark across the bridge of the muzzle, dual white spots on the cheek, and white banding on the lower limbs.
